name: Vaultwarden
summary: Lightweight self-hosted server that works with all the official Bitwarden apps.
gains: Your vault lives on your own server
tradeoffs: You are responsible for backups and security updates
setupSteps: Rent a small server and point a domain at it
Run Vaultwarden with Docker behind a reverse proxy with HTTPS (e.g. Caddy)
Point the Bitwarden apps at your server URL
Set up automatic backups of the data folder
